_doc: Engine-ready record contract for TIL-I / CEnT-S banks. The future unified test engine consumes finished banks directly and maps these JSON fields 1:1 to DB columns — designed so NO database change is needed when the engine is built. See student_pool_architecture.md for the pool/exclusion/selection contract.

eligibilityRule._doc: eligibleForProduction MUST be true only when ALL hold. The engine's unified eligible pool = every record for the chosen examProfile with eligibleForProduction=true AND poolType!=beginner (beginner is included only when the selected mode explicitly requests easier content).
eligibilityRule.noUnresolvedFigureDefect: imageAsset resolves to an existing rendered asset when the item needs a figure

studentFacingFields._doc: The ONLY fields the student-facing question object may expose. Source layer is invisible.

internalOnlyFields._doc: NEVER exposed to the student — kept for QC, copyright/source tracking, dedup, analytics, maintenance.

engineDerivedAtSeedTime._doc: Selection signals the engine computes from the content fields above at seed time — listed so the DB schema reserves columns for them and no later migration is needed. Content need not carry them.
engineDerivedAtSeedTime.stemHash: SHA-256 of normalized stem — exact/near-duplicate avoidance within a test
engineDerivedAtSeedTime.figureFamily: grouping key derived from imageAsset base — avoid repeating the same figure family
engineDerivedAtSeedTime.passageId: shared-passage key (reading/reasoning) — avoid reusing the same passage; content SHOULD tag this when a passage feeds multiple items
engineDerivedAtSeedTime.solvePatternSignature: template signature (topic+skill+questionType+numeric-shape) — avoid two items with the same solving pattern and only changed values
engineDerivedAtSeedTime.estimatedSolveTimeSec: from difficulty + section + hasFigure — used for time-budget balancing
